relevance_note: A narrative review whose Table 2 and text summarise previously published HA20 patients, giving patient-level detail for one TNFAIP3 carrier: "one Japanese patient diagnosed with autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome (ALPS) were reported to carry novel LOF mutations in the gene" (ref. 35, n = 1 column in Table 2).
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a short Python script assembled the JSON and checked spans; every Table 2 row segment was copied from the paper and the script confirmed each occurs verbatim. Review of LUBAC, OTULIN and A20 diseases. HA20 patients are summarised only in aggregate (Table 2 columns: Patients (16) n = 11 [Zhou et al.], Patients (37) n = 6, Patients (36) n = 3, Patients (35) n = 1); no total is stated, so n_patients_reported is null. Individual rows: (1) 'A patient with ALPS' = the single patient of ref. 35 (column header 'Patients (35) (n = 1)' [thin spaces in original]), described in the text and given a variant in the Figure 2 legend; Table 2 cells in this n = 1 column were treated as stated for this individual (1/1 = observed, 0/1 = excluded, '/' = not reported). (2) 'One patient' = one of Zhou et al.'s 11 patients, described in the text with CNS vasculitis and ITP; no variant is attributed to this person, so no variant row. Aggregate counts for Zhou's cohort (e.g. 11/11 oral ulcers, 0/11 panniculitis) were NOT applied to this person because they are counts without names (D-21). Not given rows: the aggregate cohorts of refs 16, 36 and 37 (no patient-level detail), and the unnamed 'a patient with HA20' in Figure 3D (dermal abscesses) and 3E (recurrent aphthous ulcers), who cannot be identified, may be the same person, and have no source reference. Variant: the review says the variant reported in ref. 35 as p.Gln415fs / c.1245_1248del should be named c.1249_1252del / p.Lys417Serfs*4 (3′ rule). variant_original_string holds the reported cDNA (c.1245_1248del); cdna_hgvs_as_stated and protein_hgvs_as_stated hold the review's corrected forms. No transcript printed. Zygosity left 'not reported': Table 1 says HA20 mutations are 'Heterozygous' only at disease level, not for this person. Table 2 has Arthritis / Arthralgias / Myalgias as three rows with identical cells (merged cells repeated by the converter), so 0/1 was read as covering all three, which is why 'arthritis or arthralgia' is excluded. 'Failure to thrive' 0/1 was mapped to checklist 'growth failure' = excluded; 'Fevers' (plural; 'presented with fevers') was mapped to 'recurrent fever' = observed; ITP was mapped to 'cytopenia (autoimmune)'. Internal inconsistencies in Table 2: Zhou column (n = 11) gives 'Elevated CRP, ESR' as 6/6 and ref. 37 column (n = 6) as 1/1; the ref. 36 column (n = 3) gives 'Effective treatment' as 0/6; 0/6; 0/6; HA20 'Lymphadenopathy' is 'Yes' while Zhou's column is 0/11. None of these affect the extracted individuals' values.
